tools.name: viewer_get_state
tools.description: Return the current BIM coordination view, candidate visibility, and plan underlay.

tools.name: viewer_reset
tools.description: Show every candidate, clear annotations, and return to the isometric view.

tools.name: sv3d_open_multi_scene
tools.description: Report the already-opened anonymous candidates and plan underlay.

tools.name: sv3d_set_view
tools.description: Switch the orthographic or isometric camera used for drawing-to-BIM inspection.

tools.name: sv3d_orbit
tools.description: Point the BIM coordination camera at an absolute world azimuth and elevation, in degrees.

tools.name: viewer_zoom
tools.description: Set the BIM coordination zoom to an absolute multiple of the fitted view; 1 is fitted, 2 is twice as close.

tools.name: viewer_pan
tools.description: Pan the BIM camera to an absolute, radius-normalised look-at offset from the visible-scene centre along camera right/up.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_view
tools.description: Fit the camera to all, visible, or one candidate model.

tools.name: sv3d_set_model_visibility
tools.description: Show every candidate, or isolate one anonymous candidate by index.

tools.name: sv3d_set_model_opacity
tools.description: Set mesh opacity for the visible BIM candidates.

tools.name: sv3d_register_overlay
tools.description: Show or hide the anonymous plan underlay registered to the models.

tools.name: sv3d_toggle_ground
tools.description: Show or hide the ground grid guide.

tools.name: sv3d_toggle_envelopes
tools.description: Show or hide the clearance envelopes around visible candidates.

tools.name: viewer_pick_point
tools.description: Return the world point under a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click visible geometry when no position is given.

tools.name: viewer_pick_vertex
tools.description: Return the existing area-measurement vertex nearest a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click near one when no position is given. Used only to re-place a vertex of a recorded area measurement.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_distance
tools.description: Measure the 3D distance between two world points on visible BIM candidates.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_plane
tools.description: Fit a least-squares plane through three or more picked world points on visible BIM candidates and report the departure of each point from it.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_area
tools.description: Measure the area enclosed by three or more picked world points on visible BIM candidates. Reports the true fit-plane area, the areas projected onto the XY, XZ and YZ planes, the perimeter and the largest departure from the fit plane.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_angle
tools.description: Measure the angle at the vertex between the rays to the first and second points, in 3D and projected onto the horizontal plane.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_measurements
tools.description: Clear BIM measurement overlays and results.

tools.name: sv3d_annotate
tools.description: Place a point annotation on visible inspection geometry.

tools.name: sv3d_set_camera
tools.description: Restore an absolute BIM coordination camera pose. Internal utility used to snap the view back to a recorded trajectory head; never an expert action and never recorded.
